native_victory_control.objective_0_and_1: Both follow ordinary team-defeat checks rather than this task-count branch.

runtime_evidence.ADV18C: Previously played new node498: category2, objective0, action1 loaded and prompt shown, ordinary defeat-enemy goal retained. Prototype graph defects were fixed in ADV18D.
runtime_evidence.ADV18E: Previously played corrected new node498: category2, objective29, action1. Ascend completed victory while enemy had40000HP; persisted completion after process restart.
runtime_evidence.limits: No new play-through of the three original objective1 donor fights during this follow-up; new editor exports tested structurally, not yet launched in RPCS3.

recommendation.parameter_note: expression_value is an authoring convenience; on disk use a valid descriptor to a constant postfix expression. Never store literal5 as a descriptor reference.
